description: Incremental Phase 2 evidence for the 0.7.0 T2/T3 backfill. Passing backfill evidence does not add a component to the package manifest's certifiedComponents list until the 0.7.0 release gate is complete.

limitations: Phase 2 browser automation currently covers the canonical Bootstrap 5.3.3 lane in Chromium; the complete 0.7.0 gate will rerun the supported Bootstrap and browser matrices.

The fixture proves explicit opt-in initialization, keyboard-focus show/focusout dismissal, aria-describedby ownership, viewport-edge placement flipping, repeated use, hidden-state disposal and reinitialization, no backdrop or scroll lock, accessibility, responsive/RTL rendering, and clean console/page-error evidence.
Bootstrap Tooltip does not own an Escape-key listener; its applicable keyboard dismissal contract is focusout. Tooltip does not create a backdrop or scroll lock.
The normalized screenshot is a render smoke and has no accepted regression baseline yet.
Real-device and generic host-conformance evidence remain pending.
Phase 2 browser automation currently covers the canonical Bootstrap 5.3.3 lane in Chromium; the complete 0.7.0 gate will rerun the supported Bootstrap and browser matrices.

The fixture proves explicit opt-in initialization, focus-triggered show and next-focus dismissal, aria-describedby ownership, non-interactive title/body content, viewport-edge placement fallback, repeated use, hidden-state disposal and reinitialization, no backdrop or scroll lock, accessibility, responsive/RTL rendering, and clean console/page-error evidence.

Bootstrap Popover does not manage focus inside its generated content and does not own an Escape-key listener; Moo UI keeps popover content non-interactive and uses Dialog for interactive focus boundaries.
The normalized screenshot is a render smoke and has no accepted regression baseline yet.
Real-device and generic host-conformance evidence remain pending.
Phase 2 promotes the existing Phase 0E Dialog pilot evidence into the complete Tier 2 report; the complete 0.7.0 gate will rerun the supported Bootstrap and browser matrices.

The existing fixture proves Data API initialization, semantic title/description wiring, focus entry and trapping, backdrop creation/removal, Escape dismissal, trigger focus return, repeated open/close use, accessibility, responsive/RTL rendering, and clean console/page-error evidence.
Bootstrap Modal owns the runtime lifecycle; Dialog adds no parallel JavaScript implementation.
The normalized screenshot is a render smoke and has no accepted regression baseline yet.
Real-device and generic host-conformance evidence remain pending.
